summary: Check push expiry inside the writer and retain every issuer's opt-out ownership

replay.detail: Push registrations remain local-only; no claims or replication change.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema change. The phone journals only safe profile identities for pending cleanup, never tokens or credentials.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Registration mutations sample expiry after writer admission. Phone opt-out cleans all previously registered issuers; Forget and independent-member removal retain credentials until remote cleanup is confirmed.

manual.detail: No upgrade step. If opt-out cannot reach a previously registered member, reconnect and retry before forgetting its pairing.

recovery.detail: Pending cleanup ownership survives phone restart and retries using current paired routes.
